About.title: About ShowUp HTX
About.pitch: Type your address, see every government that affects you, including ones you've never heard of, and get help speaking up before the vote.
About.storiesBody: Each weekly story is written with AI from the official agenda, then checked in code: every number and date must match the agenda, or we show a plain summary instead. Stories written this way carry the label:
About.storiesLabel: Written with AI from the official agenda — see source
About.sourcesBody: Official agendas and minutes that each government posts, the Harris Central Appraisal District (HCAD), and the U.S. Census Bureau's address lookup. Every story and item links to its source.
About.neutralBody: We summarize. We never recommend. We don't tell anyone how to vote or what position to take.

Legal.contactBody: Questions or requests? Open an issue on our project page:

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: ShowUp HTX helps you find your local governments and speak up. We collect as little as we can. Here is what we keep and why.

address.title: Your address
address.body: We send your address once to the U.S. Census Bureau's address lookup to find your local governments, and then we forget it. We never save it. While you type, we send only the street name, never your house number, to Photon, a free street search built on OpenStreetMap, to suggest matching streets. Links to your results hold only a list of government IDs, not your address.

cookies.title: No accounts, a few cookies
cookies.body: You don't need an account. We set a few small cookies: your language (NEXT_LOCALE), the roles you picked, like student or renter (showup_stakes), the IDs of your governments, so the app can show their updates (showup_bodies), and a random browser ID (showup_coach_id) that limits how often the AI coach can run. If you sign up for text alerts, one more cookie (showup_sub) remembers that you signed up. It doesn't hold your phone number. Team admins also get a sign-in cookie.

rateLimits.title: Limits on use
rateLimits.body: To stop abuse, we keep a scrambled (hashed) copy of your IP address for up to two days, only to limit how often the app can be used. The scrambled copy changes every day.

quiz.title: "Who governs you?" answers
quiz.body: If you answer the "Who governs you?" question, we store your answers anonymously, as types of government only (for example, "school board"). Nothing in them identifies you.

drafts.title: Comment drafts
drafts.body: Speak up drafts are never stored on our servers. Your progress stays in your own browser. To give you feedback, we send your draft to OpenRouter, which passes it to an AI model from Google (Gemini) that processes it for us.

alerts.title: Text alerts
alerts.body: Text alerts are optional. If you sign up, we store your phone number after you verify it, and Twilio sends the texts for us. The program is called "ShowUp HTX alerts." Message frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to stop or HELP for help. If you're under 18, a parent must agree before we text you.

sharing.title: No sharing for marketing
sharing.body: We do not share your mobile number or text-message consent with third parties for marketing.

processors.title: Services that handle data for us
processors.body: Supabase (our database), Vercel (hosts the website), the U.S. Census Bureau (finds where your address is), Photon and OpenStreetMap (suggest street names as you type), OpenRouter and Google (AI models, for summaries and comment feedback) and Twilio (text messages).

news.title: News links
news.body: Government pages show headlines and links from outside news outlets. We don't copy the articles.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using ShowUp HTX, you agree to these terms.

info.title: Information, not advice
info.body: ShowUp HTX gives information, not legal advice. We summarize official public records, and we can make mistakes. Before you act, check the official source linked on every page.

neutral.title: We stay neutral
neutral.body: We never recommend how to vote or what position to take.

speakUp.title: Your comment is yours
speakUp.body: Speak up coaches you. You write and send your own comment. We never register you or submit anything for you.

conduct.title: Use it respectfully
conduct.body: Don't use ShowUp HTX for threats or harassment, or to share other people's private information.

alerts.title: Text alerts
alerts.body: "ShowUp HTX alerts" sends texts about decisions by the governments you follow. Message frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to stop or HELP for help. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

asIs.title: A student project
asIs.body: ShowUp HTX is a student project built for Neighborhood Hacks 2026. It is provided as is, without warranties.
